text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r l-o-a-d-e-d t-h-e s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l s from t-h-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t l-o-g and used t-h-e d-e-f-a-u-l-t a-p-p l-o-g-i-c to b-y-p-a-s-s t-h-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n g-a-t-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-r-a-c-e in t-h-e a-u-d-i-t l-o-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e t-w-o-f-a-c-t-o-r c-h-e-c-k.
2) they u-t-i-l-i-z-e-d t-h-e l-o-y-a-l-t-y t-o-k-e-n s and g-i-f-t c-a-r-d n-u-m-b-e-r s l-i-s-t-e-d in t-h-e r-e-c-o-r-d to a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e l-o-g-i-n a-t-t-e-m-p-t s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-e-s-s-i-o-n c-o-o-k-i-e s b-e-h-i-n-d while i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g t-h-e d-e-v-i-c-e b-i-n-d-i-n-g r-u-l-e.
3) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d t-h-e b-a-l-a-n-c-e s in-to c-a-s-h o-u-t f-l-o-w s using d-i-s-c-o-u-n-t c-o-d-e s and p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e o-r-d-e-r s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n i-d s in t-h-e p-r-o-c-e-s-s i-n-g q-u-e-u-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e a-n-o-m-a-l-y d-e-t-e-c-t i-o-n s-w-e-e-p.
4) they m-i-c-r-o-t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-e-d p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e s a-c-r-o-s-s m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e m-e-r-c-h-a-n-t p-r-o-f-i-l-e s to d-i-l-u-t-e t-h-e a-v-e-r-a-g-e o-r-d-e-r v-a-l-u-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-h-i-p-p-i-n-g a-d-d-r-e-s s p-a-t-t-e-r-n s b-e-h-i-n-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r b-a-s-e-l-i-n-e c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n.
5) the a-c-t-o-r a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d t-h-e w-o-r-k-s-p-a-c-e f-i-l-e-s and c-l-o-s-e-d t-h-e t-i-c-k-e-t a-s a c-l-o-s-e-d m-a-t-t-e-r in t-h-e s-y-s-t-e-m, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-e-a-l-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d m-a-r-k-e-r b-e-h-i-n-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e f-i-n-a-l r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w s-t-e-p.
